snippet.title: FragPunk New Mode Reveal Trailer - Toys Awaken Chapter
snippet.description:
A toy party in the villa?! The FragPunk: March of the Toys event is launching on September 10!

Jump into the brand-new Prop Hunt mode with your friends, hide, seek, and cause chaos using wild new Shard Cards on the fresh map.

The toys are awakening. This time, we’re breaking the rules with them!
